status: r015 candidate; not yet deployed or trained
coordinates: SI; X forward, Y left, Z up
basis: Latest user steering supersedes the earlier +/-45 degree target: reduce the maximum articulation and add modular cargo trailers with four cranes per transport module. Candidate mechanical yaw limits are now +/-30 degrees, with tighter speed-dependent operation still to implement. Earlier 45-degree geometry/fixture and suite_v1 straight-ground evidence are historical and retained with their original configuration. Recheck clearances for added cranes, interchangeable cargo and an additional powered module; the 4 m extension is retained as available travel pending a smaller required-stroke assessment. Masses, actuator limits and terrain articulation ranges are design assumptions, not hardware ratings. Bearing axes remain yaw at reference anchor, pitch 2.2 m aft, roll 0.9 m aft of pitch.
deployment_condition: New native joint geometry, finite actuator controls, collision sweeps and cross-engine tests must pass before promotion; original r014 remains installed.
extension_policy_basis: The four-crane two-hull candidate passes 333 discrete offset-axis surface screens at 0 to 4 m extension and +/-30 deg yaw with sampled pitch/roll. Retraction (0 m) already passes the sampled nominal-suspension poses, so transport defaults to retracted. This does not certify continuous, suspended, three-module or deployed-crane clearance; mechanical locking remains to implement.
